population: All adult admissions with consistent admission fields and explicit alive/dead ICU status; no selection by predictions or effect sizes.
grouping: One physical row per patient_number, after all selected admission fields and discharge status are checked identical including missingness across repeated daily rows. Conflicting identifiers are excluded and reported, not combined field by field.
predictor_exclusions: diagnoses or treatments not explicitly mapped
admission_proxy: first heart rate as day-one maximum
first systolic pressure as day-one minimum
unit_evidence_status: Core dictionary specifies heart rate b/min and systolic pressure mmHg; age years. Temperature is listed Fahrenheit and creatinine micromol/L, but exported predictor scales are mixed and no per-record unit flags are present, so both fields and WBC remain unavailable.
models: Five median and five KNN frozen no-APACHE WiDS checkpoints; no training or recalibration; gamma and all rules fixed.
inference: 50 matched MC-dropout draws, seed 0 per checkpoint/scenario; uniform-gate identity and independent persisted replay.
analysis: All two scenarios and ten frozen models per scenario reported; paired ICU-outcome Brier and AUROC deltas with conditional admission bootstrap and Bonferroni family intervals across four imputation/scenario contrasts; five-seed mean and SD. No hospital clustering or canonical person grouping possible. No external acceptance or numerical compatibility claim under a changed endpoint.
primary_contrast: NARS minus MC-only, exploratory, with no outcome-driven scenario selection.
claim_boundary: Changes in endpoint, measurement summaries, missing inputs, assumed units and unverified source independence prevent completion of plan experiment 7. No human or clinical validation.
amendment: Before any model evaluation: the obtained CCAA core dictionary and predictor-only scale audit reveal unresolved mixed-unit fields. Replace hypothetical unit mappings with exclusion of temperature, WBC and creatinine. No model performance used in this amendment. ICU status categories have now been inspected for decoding.
